description: Turn “Show my record” on (default) or off with show true/false and a unique commandKey. Off hides the W-L, units and ROI from everyone but the account owner (zero record on posts, out of Top lists); posts stay public. Keep the caller-generated commandKey (16-120 characters) stable for this action and all retries. Action and version are fixed by this tool; do not supply them.
name: set_show_my_record
title: Show or hide my record
